name: wordtoolkit
description: Token-lean native Microsoft Word automation with 14 core/gateway tools and lazy access to 81 native actions.

interface.longDescription: WordToolkit controls the real Microsoft Word application through one persistent native .NET COM STA thread. A small 14-tool MCP surface covers the common lifecycle and batch path; search, inspect and execute gateways load any of 81 native actions only when needed. Compact responses omit echoed input and diagnostics by default. The full action set covers saved-package graphs, semantics, a unified source-linked dependency graph across OPC, semantic containment, styles, numbering, references, sections and classic charts, bounded Transitional/Strict DrawingML chart inspection without returning cached point values or opening workbooks, source-linked lint with the first reviewed create-new title repair, semantic comparison, deterministic reversible OPC patch artifacts, guarded three-way package merge, themes, settings, fonts, canonical OfficeMath, comments/threads/people/revisions/moves/permissions, modeled effective formatting, atomic style-definition creation/cloning/exact consolidation/proven-unused deletion/primary-name rename and assignment, guarded text edits and lossless tracked-revision decisions plus live formatting, Find/replace, review, tables, formulas, lists, bookmarks, fields, images, notes, headers/footers, editable Office Math, verified native plain/bold/italic/bold-italic MathML and OMML equation scopes, structures, layout, Undo, PDF and Open XML validation. Dependency keys, chart titles/formulas and source locations are redacted by default, coverage gaps remain explicit and external targets are never followed. Lint repair, semantic style mutation, patch and merge application use exact fingerprints and baseline-aware validation; unsafe consumers and ambiguity fail closed. Lint repair and merge create a new file and never overwrite, while semantic style apply uses an atomic recovery backup. Patch and merge retain independent active-content/signature/external-link/binary/error authorizations, while lint repair and semantic style apply block signed packages outright. Raw patches are confidential; an optional engine envelope supports AES-256-GCM and ECDSA-SHA256 with caller-managed keys, while MCP key provisioning remains intentionally absent. The installed Word object model remains policy-gated; macros, DDE, unsafe raw COM paths and external effects fail closed. The package contains no Python runtime.
defaultPrompt: Open or connect to my Word document and edit it live.
Create a new Word document and write this content immediately.
Generate a long document in one fast native batch.
Add a step-by-step solution with native editable equations.
Add images, comments, footnotes, headers and footers, then export a PDF.
Inspect a saved DOCX and safely accept or reject selected tracked changes.
Lint a saved DOCX and safely repair an empty document title into a new file.
Compare two saved Word documents semantically without opening Word.
Create and safely apply a reversible patch between two saved Word documents.
Consolidate proven exact duplicate custom styles in a saved Word document.
Delete proven-unused custom styles from a saved Word document.
